affiliations.role_title: Professor and Head of the Department of Political Science
affiliations.date_precision: month; source says present and lists several leave periods
affiliations.research_notes: The application says Bunche remained a Howard professor while on leave in 1941; NARA says he joined COI before Pearl Harbor. The exact transfer date is not shown in the digitized selection.
Bunche directed a survey staff and left when the survey was completed.
The file describes comparative colonial-administration research in Europe, Africa, Malaya, and the Netherlands East Indies.
The application says the contract ended after the summer institute.
The continuation sheet describes library and field research in Europe, West Africa, and North Africa.

affiliations.role_title: Acting Chief, Analysis Section, Air Transport Division
affiliations.research_notes: NARA's file introduction says Casey joined OSS in 1943 and came from BEW; the personnel history says he completed this assignment.
The chronology says Casey left for military service. A financial section says the institute continued paying 20 percent of his salary during his government assignment.

affiliations.date_precision: month; end not supplied on the reviewed form
affiliations.research_notes: The military-service section identifies Casey as a commissioned U.S. Naval Reserve lieutenant (junior grade).
The form says Casey left the partnership to work full-time at the Research Institute of America.
Goldberg's employment history explicitly gives his reason for leaving as joining OSS.
The personnel history says Goldberg left to open his own law office.
Goldberg worked first as a law clerk and then as a lawyer after admission to the bar in 1929.

affiliations.date_precision: day for start; end not supplied on the reviewed form
affiliations.research_notes: NARA's introduction says Hayden left the Marine Corps Reserve to join OSS anonymously as John Hamilton; his form gives the rank First Lieutenant.
Hayden's chronology says he operated a sailing vessel and left this self-employment to enlist in the Marine Corps Reserve.
The personnel history identifies maritime employment as mate and says Hayden left when the voyage ended.
The personnel history identifies Hayden as a shipmaster and says he left when the voyage ended.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Ralph J Bunche is Ralph Johnson Bunche, whose OSS personnel file is cataloged as NAID 2168596.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The direct file has the same name and Box 92 as the index row and gives his full middle name as Johnson.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Exact indexed name, matching archive box, and direct personnel-file linkage.
claims.temporal_assessment: The file is contemporaneous OSS personnel documentation.
claims.match_notes: A direct file-unit linkage is sufficient to confirm the identity.

claims.claim_text: Ralph Bunche's best-supported immediate pre-COI/OSS civilian affiliation was Howard University, where he remained a professor while on leave.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Professor & Head of Dept. of Political Science
claims.evidence_paraphrase: His application lists Howard from September 1928 to present and records a 1941 leave; NARA says he joined COI before Pearl Harbor.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Direct personnel file matched by exact name and box.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded but not an explicit transfer statement; the exact COI recruitment date is absent.
claims.match_notes: Howard is not inferred from education; it is explicitly listed as employment.

claims.claim_text: Howard University is the last documented civilian employer in Ralph Bunche's chronology before his COI/OSS work.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The employment record continued his Howard position through successive leaves, including one beginning in 1941.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Direct personnel file matched by exact name and box.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded; no later private or academic employer appears before COI.
claims.match_notes: This is a civilian-employer claim distinct from the immediate wartime-affiliation question.

claims.claim_text: Ralph Bunche served as a staff member and research supervisor for the Carnegie Corporation of New York from June 1939 to September 1940.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: His personnel application names the organization, role, dates, duties, and completion of the survey as his reason for leaving.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Direct personnel file matched by exact name and box.
claims.temporal_assessment: Explicitly dated before COI/OSS service; not presented as immediate.
claims.match_notes: The source directly identifies the employer rather than only a research topic.

claims.claim_text: Ralph Bunche was a postdoctoral fellow with the Social Science Research Council from September 1936 to September 1938.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Exact title of your position: Post Doctoral Fellow
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The direct employment history names the council, dates, title, and colonial-administration research.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Direct personnel file matched by exact name and box.
claims.temporal_assessment: Explicitly dated before COI/OSS service; not presented as immediate.
claims.match_notes: The fellowship is recorded as a documented affiliation, not silently converted from education.

claims.evidence_paraphrase: The personnel history supplies the organization, role, dates, and end of contract.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Direct personnel file matched by exact name and box.
claims.temporal_assessment: Explicitly dated before COI/OSS service; not presented as immediate.
